<!--
  CLEAN SLATE — Page Footer (Before </body>)

  Two tags, same commit pin. ltf.js is nav / buttons / cards / magnifier /
  vault / upsell. rock-scene.js is Three + the boulder. They must stay on
  the same hash so UI and hero cannot drift. Do not fold the rock back into
  ltf.js — a hung GLB must not stall the rest of the page.

  Import map sits immediately above the rock module so GLTFLoader's
  `from 'three'` resolves. Prefer head; footer-before-modules is valid
  because no earlier module on this page uses those specifiers.

  The mobile nav used to live here as an inline block. It is now
  js/ui/nav-mobile.js — do not paste it back, it would double-bind the toggle.
-->
<script type="importmap">
{
  "imports": {
    "three": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/build/three.module.js",
    "three/addons/": "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.165.0/examples/jsm/"
  }
}
</script>
<script type="module"
  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Staylow-flow/lowtideflow-assets@98cfa65/js/ltf.js"></script>

  src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/Staylow-flow/lowtideflow-assets@98cfa65/js/hero/rock-scene.js"></script>
